run_id_rule: A new local run_id is assigned at launch and written with the results. This file does not contain measured TTFT or hashes.
entries: First 20 entries in the W3 pin file order used by d482c621 (multi_turn_probe_entries.json under sealed_6225d6e1).
scope: Turn 0 only. One generate of the tools-plus-first-user-message ChatHistory. Not the tool-step loop.
flush_definition: Pipeline built with SchedulerConfig enable_prefix_caching false. finish_chat before every generate.
noflush_definition: One pipeline with SchedulerConfig omitted (ContinuousBatching default prefix caching on, the d482c621 plan source LLMPipeline_default_CB_prefix_caching_on). No finish_chat inside a triple. Both no-flush conditions share that pipeline. greedy_noflush runs first. finish_chat is called once between the two no-flush conditions and does not clear prefix blocks, so harness_default_noflush call 1 may already be warm. Later entries on the same pipeline may also be warm at call 1 because the tools prefix can remain.

decoding.greedy: GenerationConfig max_new_tokens 512, do_sample false, apply_chat_template true. temperature, top_p, top_k, and seed unset.

output_token_sha256: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON array of output token ids. Prefer ids on the generate result when that attribute exists; otherwise HF tokenizer encode of the generated text with add_special_tokens false. The source is recorded per call.
gates: Five measurement gates must pass before the first generate.
B1_finding: The harness generate path is greedy. _generation_cfg and OpenVinoLocalBackend set do_sample false and do not set temperature, top_p, top_k, or seed. models/Qwen3-4B-int4-ov/generation_config.json has do_sample true, temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, and no seed. That file is not the object passed to generate. The sampling branch of the task statement does not apply.
predictions: Output-token hashes are identical across the 3 calls in greedy_flush and in harness_default_flush.
greedy_flush and harness_default_flush agree with each other on each entry, because harness-default decoding is the same greedy GenerationConfig.

Because the no-flush pipeline leaves prefix caching on: greedy_noflush calls 2 and 3 have lower TTFT than call 1, and their output hashes may differ from call 1. The strongest cold call 1 is the first entry. Later entries, and harness_default_noflush call 1, may already be warm, so their within-triple TTFT gap can be smaller.
The same hash and TTFT prediction applies to harness_default_noflush, with the warm-call-1 caveat above.
